description: This file contains extension methods for working with tasks and asynchronous operations, including handling timeouts, cancellation, logging exceptions, and suppressing throw behaviors in the Orleans framework.

classes.name: Orleans.Internal.OrleansTaskExtentions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for enhanced task handling in Orleans, such as suppression, logging, timeouts, cancellation, and more.

methods.name: SuppressThrowing
methods.description: Suppresses exceptions from the given Task or ValueTask, configuring its awaiter to suppress throwing.

methods.name: Ignore
methods.description: Marks a ValueTask as ignored; if already completed successfully, it retrieves the result, otherwise, it converts to a Task and ignores.

methods.name: LogException
methods.description: Logs exceptions thrown by an asynchronous task using the provided ILogger, with an associated error code and message.

methods.name: SafeExecute
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous function ensuring that exceptions are caught and returned as a faulted Task.

methods.name: ExecuteAndIgnoreException
methods.description: Executes an async function and suppresses any exceptions thrown.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of a Task, including its Id and Status.

methods.name: WaitWithThrow
methods.description: Waits synchronously for a Task with a timeout, throwing TimeoutException if timed out.

methods.name: WaitForResultWithThrow
methods.description: Waits synchronously for a Task<T> to complete with a timeout, returning the result or throwing TimeoutException.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: Applies a timeout to an async task, throwing TimeoutException if the task does not complete within the specified duration.

methods.name: WithCancellation
methods.description: Wraps a task to support cancellation via a CancellationToken, throwing a TaskCanceledException with a message if canceled.

methods.name: WrapInTask
methods.description: Wraps an Action into a Task, returning a completed or faulted Task based on execution outcome.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Gets the result of a Task<T> in a way that propagates exceptions correctly.

methods.name: WhenCancelled
methods.description: Creates a Task that completes when the provided CancellationToken is canceled.
